why_smaller.title: Nvidia / NVDA — a huge quarter still meets a high hurdle
why_smaller.selection_evidence: CNBC reported Nvidia nearly doubling revenue on strong AI demand, while The New York Times described profit doubling as chip sales surged.[[n1965]][[n1960]] Reuters separately reported shares slipping after the bell.[[n1987]] That is the central expectations problem: a strong business result can fail to exceed the market's ambitions. The latest completed regular-session close was USD 145.89, up +4.54% over 20 sessions (Yahoo Finance, prior close 2024-11-20). Keep that dated close distinct from the separately reported earnings reaction. The attraction remains participation in AI demand, but the valuation hurdle is set by expectations rather than adjectives.
why_smaller.narrative_distinction: a huge quarter still meets a high hurdle

why_smaller.title: Target / TGT — the bargain comes with a spending problem
why_smaller.selection_evidence: Reuters reported Target expecting stagnant holiday-quarter sales, and AP News contrasted its sluggish spending picture with Walmart's stronger quarter.[[n4325]][[n1944]] TGT closed at USD 121.72 after a -21.97% session (Yahoo Finance, prior close 2024-11-20). That is an obvious temptation for the retail bargain hunter: a familiar store becomes much cheaper in a day. Investopedia's account of shoppers delaying purchases, seeking deals and stocking up gives the operating challenge a concrete shape.[[n1979]] The investment question is whether the lower valuation adequately compensates for a customer who is becoming harder to monetise.
why_smaller.narrative_distinction: the bargain comes with a spending problem

why_smaller.title: Snowflake / SNOW — a better outlook revives the cloud story
why_smaller.selection_evidence: Investopedia reported Snowflake shares popping on strong earnings and outlook, while TechCrunch reported its acquisition of data-management company Datavolo.[[n1972]][[n1974]] Those are company-specific developments that can make a cloud-software recovery easier to explain. The latest completed regular-session close was USD 129.12, up +13.65% over 20 sessions (Yahoo Finance, prior close 2024-11-20). That price anchor is separate from the reported earnings reaction. The attraction is a stronger business trajectory with an additional capability-building deal, rather than reliance on a general assumption that all software must benefit equally from AI.
why_smaller.narrative_distinction: a better outlook revives the cloud story
